chip.description: 65C816-core processor with integrated DMA/HDMA, controller ports, multiply/divide registers and the SNES system timing (taxonomy §6 adjudication: TB1, the core absorbs the rest).
chip.notes: Classification fixed by docs/taxonomy.md §6. MAME 0.288 defines the device in src/devices/cpu/g65816/g65816.cpp as _5A22, short name "5a22", full name "Ricoh 5A22".
